name: Gnoll Rogue 2/Sorcerer 4
body:
This female gnoll, dressed in a cloak, has a hawk on one shoulder and a slightly crazed look in her eye.

Gnoll Rogue 2/Sorcerer 4
CR 6

XP 2,400
Female gnoll rogue 2/sorcerer 4
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+4 armor, +1 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 natural, +4 shield)
hp 52 (8 HD; 4d8+4d6+20)
Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +5
Defensive Abilities evasion

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk spear +8 (1d8+4/x3
Ranged mwk light crossbow +7 (1d8/19-20)
Special Attacks sneak attacks +1d6

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 4th; concentration +10; ranged touch +6; spell failure 15% [5% if using Arcane Armor Training])

2nd (4/day)—identify, scorching ray
1st (7/day)––burning hands (DC 13), magic missile, shield
0 (At will)—acid splash, flare (DC 12), ghost sound (DC 12), message, prestidigitation, ray of frost
Bloodline arcane

TACTICS

She casts shield on herself before stepping onto the field of battle. She lets her allies engage foes in melee while she provides support with scorching rays and magic missiles. In melee, she relies on burning hands unless she has a chance to try a sneak attack, in which case she uses her spear. She fights to the death.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 8, Cha 14
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Arcane Armor Training, Combat Casting, Combat ReflexesB, Eschew MaterialsB, Iron Will, Skill Focus (perception)
Skills Intimidate +10, Acrobatics +10, Perception +13(+16 in bright light)
Languages Common, Gnoll
SQ arcane bond (hawk named Eddia), metamagic adept, rogue talents (combat training), trapfinding +1
Combat Gear +1 studded leather, masterwork spear, masterwork light crossbow, cloak of resistance +1, ring of protection +1; Other Gear obsidian unholy symbol worth 200 gp, 45 gp
